R1: after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG +28% for 6s.

en.flavor: A long spear tainted black by unrelenting battle, it shines with an ethereal glow beneath the ghostly blue light of lantern-fire.

refinements.1: For 3.5s after using an Elemental Burst, the equipping character's Lunar-Charged DMG dealt to opponents is increased by <r>36%</r>. Additionally, after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, the equipping character will gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG is increased by <r>28%</r> for 6s. They will also regain <r>12</r> Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 14s.

Additionally, after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, the equipping character will gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG is increased by <r>35%</r> for 6s. They will also regain <r>13</r> Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 14s.
refinements.3: For 3.5s after using an Elemental Burst, the equipping character's Lunar-Charged DMG dealt to opponents is increased by <r>60%</r>. Additionally, after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, the equipping character will gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG is increased by <r>42%</r> for 6s. They will also regain <r>14</r> Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 14s.
refinements.4: For 3.5s after using an Elemental Burst, the equipping character's Lunar-Charged DMG dealt to opponents is increased by <r>72%</r>. Additionally, after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, the equipping character will gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG is increased by <r>49%</r> for 6s. They will also regain <r>15</r> Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 14s.
refinements.5: For 3.5s after using an Elemental Burst, the equipping character's Lunar-Charged DMG dealt to opponents is increased by <r>84%</r>. Additionally, after triggering a Lunar-Charged reaction, the equipping character will gain Requiem of Ruin: CRIT DMG is increased by <r>56%</r> for 6s. fr.flavor: Une longue lance teintée de noir par une bataille acharnée, brillant d'une lueur éthérée sous la lumière bleue fantomatique du feu de la lanterne.

refinements.1: Pendant 3,5 s après avoir utilisé un déchaînement élémentaire, les DGT infligés aux ennemis par les réactions de Sélénocution du personnage équipé de l'arme augmentent de <r>36 %</r>. De plus, le personnage équipé de l'arme obtient l'effet Requiem de ruine après avoir déclenché une réaction de Sélénocution : augmente ses DGT CRIT de <r>28 %</r> pendant 6 s et lui restaure <r>12</r> pts d'énergie élémentaire, l'énergie élémentaire pouvant être restaurée une fois toutes les 14 s de cette manière.

pt.flavor: Uma lança longa pintada de preto por causa de incontáveis batalhas, reluz com um brilho etéreo sob a luz azulada fantasmagórica do fogo da lanterna.

refinements.1: Nos 3.5s depois de lançar o Supremo, aumenta o Dano de Carga Lunar causado pelo personagem que está com essa arma equipada em <r>36%</r>. Além disso, quando o personagem que está com essa arma equipada desencadear Carga Lunar, obtém Canção Desolada: aumenta o Dano CRIT em <r>28%</r> por 6s, e regenera <r>12</r> de Energia Elemental para o personagem que está com essa arma equipada. Esse efeito de regeneração de Energia Elemental pode ser ativado uma vez a cada 14s.

zh.flavor: 于漫长的战斗中染成漆黑的长枪，在幽蓝的火光照耀下散发着别样的光辉。

refinements.1: 施放元素爆发后的3.5秒内，装备者对敌人造成的月感电反应伤害提高<r>36%</r>。此外，装备者触发月感电反应后，将获得「荒落的挽歌」：暴击伤害提高<r>28%</r>，持续6秒；并为装备者恢复<r>12</r>点元素能量，每14秒至多通过这种方式恢复一次元素能量。
